caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with an upholstered seat placed against a plain light background. The chair has four straight legs, with the front legs slightly tapered and the back legs gently curving outward. The seat is rectangular with rounded front corners and is covered in a muted green fabric with a decorative trim, likely tacked or sewn along the edge. The chair’s arms curve outward and then downward, connecting to the top of the front legs, and feature smooth, rounded surfaces. The backrest is upright and features a geometric decorative pattern made from the same wood as the rest of the chair, consisting of intersecting curves and vertical lines. The wood is illustrated in shades of brown, emphasizing the grain and contours. The drawing is bordered by a thin, rectangular outline set slightly in from the edge of the paper.
title: Armchair
